basis: Previously reviewed the page-2 FIA Competition Notes - Pirelli Preview screenshot and matched it to the exact PDF SHA-256 below. The sheet specifies 29.0/>=30.0 psi front and 27.5/>=28.5 psi rear slick pressures, -2.75/-1.50 degree camber limits, mandatory C1/C2 race tyres, C3 for Q3, and a 27-lap maximum across tyre history. Updated Qatar Tyres/Notes copy to attribute these prescriptions to the FIA source. Pirelli's 24 November infographic independently matches the pressures and adds a 26.5-second average pit-stop loss. The FIA sheet does not resolve Formula1.com's conflicting per-driver set totals (2/3/8 plus a Q3 Soft versus 2/4/7); these remain explicitly conflicting, not transcribed as an allocation. Existing Power Unit Information review and its separate energy/Overtake interpretation remain unchanged. On 26 November, visually reviewed the hash-matched FIA Car Display Procedure screenshot: it governs the Friday car presentation window, display-car selection and weather/logistics only, not upgrade submissions; added that distinction to Upgrades, Schedule and Notes while leaving the still-unlisted team submissions pending. Also visually reviewed Qatar Doc 5: it summons Car 11 / Sergio Perez and the Cadillac team representative over alleged late Thursday press-conference attendance, requires a report at 18:30 local on Friday 27 November, and makes no finding or penalty; added it as a note with its own collapsed source reader, separate from the carried-over Las Vegas grid penalty. The current FIA listing had no circuit-map PDF, while Formula1.com's current 2026 Lusail map is collected and live. The newly reviewed FIA 2026 Lusail Event Document 5 (map version 1, issued 24 November; PDF published 26 November) separately marks DRS detection 55 m after Turn 15 and activation 190 m after Turn 16. These are drag-reduction points, not Straight Mode or ERS Overtake points. The source is retained as a supplemental official PDF because the Qatar Grand Prix listing checked at 17:48Z did not include it; its substantive page 2 screenshot was visually reviewed.
